```python
Op(name: str, id: int, operands: tuple[Value, ...] = (), attributes: dict[str, Any] = dict(), regions: tuple[Region, ...] = (), results: tuple[Value, ...] = (), location: Optional[Location] = None, parent: Optional[Block] = None)
```

Part of [`evoxc.ir`](/api/evoxc/ir/)

One instruction in a `Block`.

## Attributes

- `name` · `str` — Registered op name (see `opdef`); unknown names fail in
  `verify` and in `opdef` lookups.

- `id` · `int` — Module-unique op id (assigned by the `Builder`; stable for
  serialization).

- `operands` · `tuple[Value, ...]` — Consumed `Value`s.

- `attributes` · `dict[str, Any]` — Static (JSON-able) parameters specializing the op; schema
  declared in the `OpDef`.

- `regions` · `tuple[Region, ...]` — Nested bodies for control-flow ops (`if` holds true/false,
  `while` holds cond/body); entry-block arguments are bound to the
  op's operands (see CONTEXT.md, "Nested regions").

- `results` · `tuple[Value, ...]` — Produced `Value`s — built by the `Builder`, which assigns
  ids and infers (or takes explicit) result types.

- `location` · `Optional[Location]` — Optional source position; never affects semantics.

- `parent` · `Optional[Block]` — The owning `Block` (wired on insertion), or None.

## effect

The declared effect kind (one of `EFFECT_KINDS`).

## is_terminator

True if this op terminates its block (`return` in v1).

## opdef

The registered `OpDef` for this op's name.

The registry is consulted on every access (op defs may be registered
at runtime); only the lazy import of the registry callable is cached
(see `_load_opdef_lookup`).

## result

The single result of this op.

### Raises

- `ValueError` — If the op does not have exactly one result.
